name: Non-confocal Neural Transient Field (NeTF) Formulation
definition: A method to formulate the transient signal in non-confocal Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) imaging by integrating energy over semi-ellipsoids defined by foci at the illumination spot P and detection spot P' on the relay wall.
summary: Non-confocal NeTF models NLOS imaging for distinct illumination and detection spots by integrating over semi-ellipsoids, differing from confocal methods via ellipsoidal coordinates for asymmetric paths.
